scope: Read-only TradingView reconciliation of the two rebuilt roots before any mutating run. Not compile evidence, not replay evidence, not layout or rollback evidence.

SMC HTF Confluence.note: The account already carries the rebuilt source; a mutating save would be a no-op rather than a deployment. The raw hash differs from the repository hash only because the editor readback normalises trailing whitespace — a byte diff after normalisation is empty.

SMC Session Context.note: Absent, so the preflight would create a fresh private draft (explicitly allowed by the runbook).

observability.conclusion: Unlike the R4 Context surfaces, neither R5 root hides its diagnostics behind display.none; both render on-chart status tables. The replay cases are therefore readable from the chart without inventing an observability mechanism.

blockers.detail: The runbook mandates the private layout 'SMC HTF Context R5 Validation'. Its existence could not be confirmed: the TradingView layout menu did not render under automation, and no layout-listing API is reachable. Creating or choosing the layout is an operator step.
R5-REBUILD-LIVE-NO-REPAINT requires an open regular session; the survey ran post-close. Executable from the next US regular session onwards.

R5-REBUILD-DST-EU-GAP, R5-REBUILD-DST-STANDARD and R5-REBUILD-EXTENDED pin historical UTC checkpoints and need TradingView Bar Replay. No reusable replay driver exists in the repository; the R2.4 precedent drove it interactively.

unaffected.r4ShadowLayout: SMC Context R4 Shadow still carries SMC Context Bus and SMC Context Overlay after the rollback drill.
unaffected.mutationsPerformed: none — this survey opened scripts read-only and saved nothing
